content.tex: Section A
Investigation Frame sums
You are advised to spend no longer than 45 minutes on this section.
In this investigation you will look at calculations in a frame moving on a number grid.
The frame is made of 3 squares. The frame moves on a number grid.
Consecutive whole numbers fill a grid of width 8. The grid continues downwards.
To find the frame sum for any frame:
\(\bullet\) square the number on the right \(\bullet\) multiply the two numbers on the left \(\bullet\) subtract the second answer from the first answer.
Example
frame sum \(= 103\) 27
Use the grid to complete the frame and find the frame sum.
